assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='1cc96d58b508640b344f9fa2e64a14f0ba63babc28e7f2ec82a688cfa420f096'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_hgkda_reference_closure_v2',p)
